summary: Most dossiers rest on solid long-established Twin Cities history and agree with CURRENT FACTS on the 2026 season, roster moves, Cup, Christmas, MLK Day and Charlotte dates; no dossier contradicted the verified facts on roster, coach or last season. Corrections made in place: Edwards mislabelled as Nike-adjacent, the 1986 naming-contest voters, Faribault Woolen Mill history and name, Hüsker Dü and Twin/Tone, the Hymie's neighborhood, an invented MEA-break shopping window, the Purple Rain 2019-20 debut presented as fact, and the Oct 30 first-home-game assumption. Brief problems for the editor: strategy.json states Purple Rain ran in 2019-20 and twice, treats the unverified 2026-27 City Edition as a live design brief, claims Hmong New Year coincides with the Nov 24-25 Cup nights, calls Oct 30 the first home game, and uses Faribault Mill since 1865. The rest is a verification queue of small businesses (Askov Finlayson, Loon Cafe, Nike doors, Vinai and other restaurants, Familia), event dates, brand deals, Towns status and arena naming. No live searches were run because the session search budget is reserved.
